units: <cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 21:6">Targ. O. Ex. XXI, 6</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maaser Sheni 5:3:9">Y. Maas. Sh. V, 56ᵇ</cite> sq. <he>מַרְצְעָה דעקיבא וכ׳</he> the awl (penetrating acumen) of Akiba … has been here.

senses.gloss: (cmp. רְצוּעָה) strap.—Pl. מַרְצְעַיָּיה, contr. מַרְצַיָּיה. Y. Sot. I, 16ᵈ bot. [read:] לא הוינן מייתין ספסלייה ומ׳ ומלקין ליה ומרציין וכ׳ should we not have brought in benches and straps and smitten him and reconciled him to his wife?
